answer_1.quote: We investigated accelerating input by allowing users to skip typing spaces and mid-word vowels... We modified a probabilistic recognizer to accurately expand abbreviated input...
answer_1.outputs: Expanded full sentences from abbreviated input

answer_2.quote: We measured accuracy using character error rate (CER)... We also report word error rate (WER), and sentence error rate (SER) as well as Top-5 SER.

answer_4.quote: We conducted a user study using a touchscreen web application... 28 Amazon Mechanical Turk workers... measured entry rate in words-per-minute (wpm) and error rate (CER).
answer_4.guideline: Participants typed phrases in WORD and SENTENCE modes; we measured entry rate (wpm), error rate (CER), and percentage of completely correct phrases.
